summary: Rewrote the concise commentary (sections/concise/10-commentary.tex) around three questions that more than one interpretation answers — who the saints of the feast are, what the fear of the Lord is and what it is promised, and when and where the reward is had — setting the authorities of different interpretations side by side within each unit, stating each interpretation's controlling claim where its unit reaches it, and closing with a four-senses comparison only (no reprint of 50-comparison.tex); all listed claim-local qualifications kept, no source or locus added, copied eight-word-run prose reduced from 56% to about 16% of the commentary's own prose. Cleared advisories SYN-002, SYN-003 and SYN-004(a) in 04-themes.tex, 10-commentary.tex and 03-date-location.tex; left SYN-004(b) because the place phrases reprint the reviewed study appendix, which this stage may not edit. Updated the shared revision timestamp (2026-10-28T15:37:20Z) and appended the iteration record to research/production-review.md. Author proof: 11 physical pages, opening markers on pages 1/1/2/3-4/5, no overfull/underfull/undefined/rerun warnings; component artifacts check, component contract and all 12 synthesis content-preflight checks pass. This dispatch contributed the rewrite of the concise study's commentary into interleaved question units and the advisory repairs on its themes and date pages, with a fresh author proof. Defect for the shared-format owner: a section's running head is set on the page where the preceding section ends mid-page (proof p. 9 prints 'Scope and References' above the end of the commentary).
